summary: Backend + smoke frontend testing for Outdooroots. 27/27 pytest backend tests pass covering health, JWT auth, itinerary PDF (basic/empty/max-30-experiences/ES accents), booking lifecycle (personal, group quote-required, zero-days, invalid contact, duplicate destinations, itinerary order mismatch, overcapacity), admin PATCH workflow (contact timestamps, lost-reason gating), quote save + EUR math (100000 CLP cost, 20% margin, qty 2, FX 1000 -> 250 EUR exactly), quote rejects (margin=100, future FX date, expired validity, unapproved, zero FX), admin proposal PDF gated by saved quote and auth, 404 on unknown booking. Fixed a real backend bug that produced 500 on every /api/itinerary/pdf call. Frontend smoke: home renders (navy/cream/serif), EN/ES toggle switches copy, three start entry points (start-personal/start-group/start-signature) + three choose-signature-* apply CTAs present, AdventureBrief renders 3 steps, /admin login succeeds with provided credentials and shows 11 existing preserved inquiries with search/stage/destination/type/date filters, analytics cards (Inquiries, Overdue, Mean first contact, Proposal->confirmed, Confirmed quote value) with actual-events disclaimer visible.
action_items: None blocking. Bug found and fixed by test agent: itinerary_pdf.py KeepInFrame.wrap() was called without a canvas attached, causing AttributeError 'KeepInFrame' object has no attribute 'canv' and a 500 on every /api/itinerary/pdf call. Fixed by assigning flowable.canv = pdf before .wrap() on the three KeepInFrame instances (title, body, footer). Main agent should review the fix in /app/backend/itinerary_pdf.py and consider using a Frame or platypus.doctemplate for a more idiomatic solution.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager for FastAPI >=0.109.
itinerary_pdf.render_itinerary_pdf directly assigns KeepInFrame.canv (private attribute) as a workaround — brittle across reportlab upgrades. Prefer using a Frame or SimpleDocTemplate.
InquiryUpdate.follow_up_date is `date` but Mongo stores as isoformat via model_dump(mode='json') — verify Admin.js reads it back as string not object.

PackageSnapshot.validate_schedule computes 'expected' destination ids per day but does not verify per-day 'destination' name or 'accommodation' alignment; a client could send mismatched labels while ids match.
CORS uses '*' by default with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set in production.
seed_data_creation: Created QA_-prefixed bookings during pytest run: QA_Personal_Booking, QA_Group_Booking, QA_Zero, QA_AdminFlow, QA_Lost, QA_NoQuote (personal, 2-3 days each). All contact emails use @outdooroots.example.com. Not deleted (no DELETE endpoint exposed); main agent may prune via mongo shell if desired. All existing 11 preserved historical inquiries remain intact and visible in /admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_outdooroots_api.py; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` (uses -n 2 loadscope from pytest.ini). Base URL sourced from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin login: admin@chiletravel.com / Patagonia!2026. Signature/start CTAs render on Home; brief has 3 steps in AdventureBrief; admin has search/stage/destination/type filters + 5 analytics cards. Frontend deep-flow (full builder → 5 regions with reorder/timeline dates/PDF download → booking submit → admin quote editor line editing → reviewed PDF UI) was NOT exercised end-to-end via Playwright; backend equivalents are covered in pytest but a UI regression pass on desktop AND mobile is still recommended before ship.
rca of the issue: Bug: /api/itinerary/pdf and /api/bookings/{id}/proposal.pdf returned 500 for every payload. Root cause: reportlab's KeepInFrame.wrap() internally calls _listWrapOn(...) which dereferences self.canv on inner flowables when the KeepInFrame itself has never been placed inside a Frame/BaseDocTemplate — resulting in AttributeError 'KeepInFrame' object has no attribute 'canv'. Reproduction: POST /api/itinerary/pdf with any valid PackageSnapshot. Fix applied: set `flowable.canv = pdf` on the three KeepInFrame instances (title, body, footer) before calling .wrap() in /app/backend/itinerary_pdf.py. After fix, all 4 PDF tests (basic, zero-day, 30-experiences max payload, ES/unicode) return 200 with valid %PDF headers.
